                              [--jit-native-calls] [--jit-native-call-stubs]
                              [--jit-persistent-registers]
                              [--jit-resumable-calls]

Freshly collect and replay a discovered test list in bounded, recorded
batches. This is body execution coverage, not a full libtest or performance
measurement. Each collection and replay child takes the benchmark lock. The
coordinator releases its lock before launching either child to avoid waiting
on itself. No compiler cache or artifact is deleted. A failed child needs an
explicit audit; resume accepts only fully committed batches followed by an
untouched next batch.

optional arguments:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --run-id RUN_ID
  --tool-key TOOL_KEY
  --project {pgrust,fre,nushell,ruff}
  --package PACKAGE
  --entries ENTRIES
  --discovery-record DISCOVERY_RECORD
  --previous-results PREVIOUS_RESULTS
                        compare every outcome and available artifact hash
  --batch-size BATCH_SIZE
  --stop-after-batches STOP_AFTER_BATCHES
                        stop at a completed batch boundary; --resume continues
  --resume
  --instruction-limit INSTRUCTION_LIMIT
  --allocation-limit ALLOCATION_LIMIT
  --std-mir
  --inline-leaves
  --trap-unsupported-calls
  --run-try-callbacks
  --guest-mir-opt-level {0,1,2,3}
  --guest-mir-inline-scale {1,2,4,8}

Survey selected existing test bodies without executing them.

optional arguments:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --project {pgrust,fre,nushell,ruff}
  --package PACKAGE
  --entries ENTRIES     JSON names from the native test listing
  --discovery-record DISCOVERY_RECORD
                        native --list command and provenance JSON
  --tool-key TOOL_KEY   use an immutable installed exporter instead of
                        building current sources
  --sample SAMPLE       deterministic name-hash sample; default is the
                        complete list
  --selection SELECTION
                        explicit subset of the verified native listing, for
                        bounded audit batches
  --std-mir
  --guest-mir-opt-level {0,1,2,3}
                        explicit MIR optimization for the collected guest
                        programs
  --guest-mir-inline-scale {1,2,4,8}
                        scale pinned MIR inlining thresholds; requires
                        --guest-mir-opt-level=3
  --inline-leaves       apply the experimental bounded leaf inliner to each
                        exported body
  --trap-unsupported-calls
                        retain explicit runtime stops for unavailable direct
                        foreign calls and catch_unwind intrinsics
  --run-try-callbacks   run catch_unwind try callbacks; actual unwinding
                        remains unsupported
  --retain-audit-bodies
                        retain bounded, hashed programs for a separate
                        execution survey
  --run-id RUN_ID
